name: Baros Alexston
summary: In Stormwind City Hall, Baros Alexston keeps watch over the capital he helped rebuild. Once a close friend of Edwin VanCleef in the Stonemasons Guild, he stayed loyal to the crown when the guild fractured.

sections.title: From the Farmstead to the Scaffold
sections.body: Baros grew up on the Alexston Farmstead in Westfall's rolling grasslands. Thieves overran and burned the family homestead while he was young. Before they fled, his father hurriedly hid their cherished heirlooms across the grounds. Baros later journeyed to the capital and joined the Stonemasons Guild. For years, he labored beside Guildmaster Edwin VanCleef as they raised Stormwind anew from the ashes of the First War.

sections.title: A Bitter Parting of Ways
sections.body: When Stormwind's rebuilding ended, the House of Nobles refused the agreed payment. Furious protests followed, the Stonemasons Guild dissolved, and deadly riots filled the streets. Edwin VanCleef led the unpaid artisans into exile, where they formed the Defias Brotherhood. The nobles offered Baros the post of City Architect if he disavowed the uprising. Baros disagreed with the guild's turn toward violent banditry and accepted, leaving a bitter rift between himself and his former comrades.

sections.title: The Ghost in the Dead Mines
sections.body: Baros oversees the capital's upkeep from his desk in City Hall, and Mathias Shaw of SI:7 discreetly owes him a favor. After VanCleef fell in the depths of the Deadmines, an unsent letter addressed to Baros remained on the Defias leader's corpse. Its presence recalls the bond broken by politics, treason, and bloodshed over Stormwind's foundations.

faq.q: Where can I find Baros Alexston?
faq.answer: You can find Baros Alexston inside Stormwind City Hall, on the north side of Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

faq.q: What is Baros Alexston's role in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Baros oversees Stormwind City's construction, upkeep, and architectural planning as its Chief Architect.

faq.q: How does Baros know Edwin VanCleef?
faq.answer: Baros and Edwin VanCleef were close colleagues in the Stonemasons Guild, laboring side by side to rebuild Stormwind after the First War. When the House of Nobles refused to pay the workers, VanCleef led a rebellion while Baros stayed to become City Architect.

faq.q: Why didn't Baros join the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Baros disagreed with the guild's turn toward violent revolt. The nobles offered him the City Architect post on the condition that he refuse to follow VanCleef, and Baros accepted.

faq.q: What is the unsent letter found on Edwin VanCleef?
faq.answer: After Edwin VanCleef died in the Deadmines, an unsent letter addressed to Baros Alexston was found on his body. It speaks to lingering resentment and unresolved history between the former craftsmen.

faq.q: What is Baros Alexston's connection to Westfall?
faq.answer: Baros grew up on the Alexston Farmstead in Westfall, and after thieves burned it, his family fled. He recruits adventurers to reclaim his childhood possessions, including his first compass.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can see in Baros the painful compromise that split the Stonemasons Guild. Its craftsmen had poured their lives into rebuilding the capital.
As a rogue in Stormwind, you have a connection through Baros to Master Mathias Shaw and SI:7, who quietly owe the architect a favor despite his past ties to VanCleef.
As a human from Westfall, you may recognize Baros's surname from the ruined Alexston Farmstead, now overrun by thieves and gnolls.
